resources.title: Complete Beginner's Guide to Building Basics | No Man's Sky Base Building Essentials
resources.creator: Beeblebum
resources.noteEs: Punto de partida canónico para entender el sistema de construcción: piezas básicas, terrenos, energía y agua. Primera entrega de la serie Base Building Essentials de Beeblebum.
resources.noteEn: Canonical starting point for understanding the building system: base parts, terrain, power and water. First entry in Beeblebum's Base Building Essentials series.

resources.title: The BEST Snap Techniques for Clean Builds | No Man's Sky Base Building Essentials
resources.creator: Beeblebum
resources.noteEs: Half-hour deep dive sobre snapping — la mecánica que separa bases tristes de bases impecables. Cubre offsets, glitches útiles y trucos de alineación que no son obvios.
resources.noteEn: Half-hour deep dive on snapping — the mechanic that separates messy bases from polished ones. Covers offsets, useful glitches and alignment tricks that aren't obvious.

resources.title: How to find YOUR Perfect Location | No Man's Sky Base Building Essentials
resources.creator: Beeblebum
resources.noteEs: Cómo elegir el planeta y bioma correctos antes de plantar la primera base. Criterios prácticos: power, agua, sentinels, climate, FPS. Decisión que parece menor pero impacta horas.
resources.noteEn: How to pick the right planet and biome before planting your first base. Practical criteria: power, water, sentinels, climate, FPS. A seemingly small choice that compounds over hours.

resources.title: How I Built a Low Orbit Base in 2026 | UPDATED | No Man's Sky | Step-by-Step Tutorial
resources.creator: Henry Sparks
resources.noteEs: Tutorial paso a paso para construir una base en órbita baja, una de las builds más espectaculares y técnicamente complejas. Versión actualizada al patch de 2026.
resources.noteEn: Step-by-step tutorial for a low-orbit base, one of the most spectacular and technically complex builds. Version updated for the 2026 patch.

resources.title: Building in #NoMansSky Made EASY with These Pro Tips
resources.creator: GoodGuysFree!
resources.noteEs: Compendio de pro tips concretos: ajustes de cámara, atajos de keyboard, rotación fina de piezas y trucos para evitar los bugs típicos de building.
resources.noteEn: Compendium of concrete pro tips: camera adjustments, keyboard shortcuts, fine piece rotation and tricks to avoid the typical building bugs.
